assessment.basis: Every compared free coefficient meets both the recorded combined-two-sigma comparison and parameter-specific numerical similarity screen. Error conventions and fit qualifications remain applicable.
qualifications: Coefficient parity within published 1-sigma widths, not recovery of an unpublished weighting protocol. Pressure errors, gold volumes and source covariance are absent. Printed zero volume errors are retained, never treated as infinite weights. Volume-objective sensitivity fits are in the paper-specific reproduction.

parameter_provenance.determination_method: Measurements or their experimental reduction determine this EOS; source: Sections 2, 3.1-3.3 and 4.2; Tables 1-4; Figures 2-5; Erratum, page 6983; Supporting Text S1 and Tables S1-S4.
parameter_provenance.equation: Section 3.3 cites Birch (1978): P=3K0/2*(eta^7-eta^5)*[1+3/4*(K0_prime-4)*(eta^2-1)], eta=(V0/V)^(1/3). K0_prime=4 reduces exactly to BM2. No thermal term.
parameter_provenance.V0: Table 3 and Section 3.3: fixed to source ambient volume; keep final EOS table value despite differing ambient structural tables.
parameter_provenance.K0_prime: Section 3.3: fixed 4 for CaCl2 type; fixed 4.59 adopted from Andrault et al. (2003) for both stishovites.
parameter_provenance.uncertainty: Tables 3-4: estimated 1 sigma. No source covariance or weighting protocol. Null fixed-parameter errors do not mean error-free measurement.
parameter_provenance.volume_normalization: angstrom cubed per conventional primitive rutile/orthorhombic cell, Z=2; no molar or atom conversion.

superseded_record_text.notes: Al-free sample; water inferred from volume calibration, not directly measured by SIMS/IR/TGA on this specimen. Raman confirms structural OH qualitatively. Preserve Table 1 Si0.954O2H0.184: its mass-equivalent H2O is about 2.81 wt%, within the reported 3.2(5) wt% range but not exactly its central value. H retention at high pressure is inferred, not measured. No atomic coordinates were refined (Section 2). The 28-42 GPa interval is two-phase coexistence, excluded from both hydrous EOS fits. CaCl2-type Pnnm denotes the Si-O framework refinement model; hydrogen ordering and a possible delta-AlOOH-related subgroup are unresolved (Section 3.2). Table 3 fixed V0=47.191 is retained, not replaced by Table 2 47.198. The cell axes imply 47.198696 A^3.
